issue.title: can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]
issue.body:
#### Problem
From the following setup:
```
Ruby Gems:
fluent-plugin-elasticsearch-1.9.5
elasticsearch-api-5.0.4
elasticsearch-5.0.4
elasticsearch-transport-5.0.4

td-agent/fluentd: td-agent-2.3.2-0.el6.x86_64

Elastic search server: elasticsearch-5.5.2
```



We are seeing these repeated errors under td-agent (fluentd) logs and also on Elastic search via Kibana (the only constant is "can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]"):

```
Could not push log to Elasticsearch: {"took"=>0, "errors"=>true, "items"=>[{"index"=>{"_index"=>"logstash-2017.09.11", "_type"=>"fluentd", "_id"=>"AV5yQKtGv64wLrT3KbsR", "status"=>500, "error"=>{"type"=>"illegal_state_exception", "reason"=>"can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]"}}}, {"index"=>{"_index"=>"logstash-2017.09.11", "_type"=>"fluentd", "_id"=>"AV5yQKtGv64wLrT3KbsS", "status"=>500, "error"=>{"type"=>"illegal_state_exception", "reason"=>"can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]"}}}, {"index"=>{"_index"=>"logstash-2017.09.11", "_type"=>"fluentd", "_id"=>"AV5yQKtGv64wLrT3KbsT", "status"=>500, "error"=>{"type"=>"illegal_state_exception", "reason"=>"can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]"}}}]}
```

All these errors have this pattern:
```
"error"=>{"type"=>"illegal_state_exception", "reason"=>"can't select channel size is 0 for types: [RECOVERY, BULK, STATE]"}
```

#### Steps to replicate

This is our td-agent (fluentd) config:

```
<match *.**>
  buffer_chunk_limit 64m
  buffer_queue_limit 500
  type elasticsearch
  hosts index1:9200,index2:9200
  logstash_format true
  flush_interval 30s
  request_timeout 100s
  flush_at_shutdown true
  buffer_type file
  buffer_path /opt/buffer/td-agent/all.*.buffer
  retry_limit 17
  num_threads 8
  reload_on_failure true
  reload_connections true
  reconnect_on_error true
</match>

```

What is causing this problem?  How do we resolve?
